Topics · One God, one message

How do I know my opinions aren't my ego?

Asking is a good sign. Can you decline to clear yourself, know yourself, and speak truth against yourself?

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَمَآ أُبَرِّئُ نَفْسِىٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلنَّفْسَ لَأَمَّارَةٌۢ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ إِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّىٓ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."[601]

Translator's notes

[601] Although Ibn Katheer attributes the words of verses 52-53 to the wife of al-ʿAzeez, others have concluded that they were spoken by Joseph, thereby justifying his request for an inquiry and acknowledging Allāh's mercy to him.

Quran · Yusuf 12:53

Translation

Don’t go after your lusts. Restrain your appetites. If you give fully to your soul the delight of her desire, she will make you the laughing stock of your enemies. Don’t make merry in much luxury, and don’t be tied to its expense.

Original · Ancient Greek

Ὀπίσω τῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν σου μὴ πορεύου, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ὀρέξεών σου κωλύου. Ἐὰν χορηγήσεῃς τῇ ψυχῇ σου εὐδοκίαν ἐπιθυμίας, ποιήσει σε ἐπίχαρμα τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου. Μὴ εὐφραίνου ἐπὶ πολλῇ τρυφῇ, μηδὲ προσδεθῇς συμβολῇ αὐτῆς.

Sirach · 18:30-32

World English Bible

If you worry your opinions might be your ego, you are in a good place to start. To ask is already to look. The verse records someone at a moment of vindication, when claiming purity would have been easy, saying: I do not clear my own self. Then it describes the self as pushing toward harm, except where mercy steps in. So the start is not proving you are objective. It is to stop acquitting yourself in advance.

A question for you

Which of your opinions do you defend more fiercely than it deserves?

If you sayOne about people
ThenNotice what that opinion gives you about yourself. A view of others is often a view of ourselves.
If you sayOne on religion or politics
ThenThat ties to a group, not only an idea. It comes up in a later question: what proof do I have other than being raised in it?
If you sayI cannot name one
ThenThat is fine. Try asking someone who knows you well; others often know before we do.

Part 2 of 3

﴿بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ١٤ وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ١٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,[1804] Even if he presents his excuses.

Translator's notes

[1804] As described in 36:65 and 41:20-23.

Quran · Al-Qiyamah 75:14-15

Translation

Before judgment, examine yourself, and in the hour of scrutiny you will find forgiveness. Humble yourself before you get sick. In the time of sins, repent.

Original · Ancient Greek

Πρὸ κρίσεως ἐξέταζε σεαυτόν, καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ἐπισκοπῆς εὑρήσεις ἐξιλασμόν. Πρὶν ἀῤῥωστῆσαί σε ταπεινώθητι, καὶ ἐν καιρῷ ἁμαρτημάτων δεῖξον ἐπιστροφήν.

Sirach · 18:20-21

World English Bible

You do not always need an outside judge, because there is a witness in you. The verses say a person sees clearly into themselves, even while offering excuses. Notice that excuses come after knowing, not before. A long excuse may be a sign you know something you would rather not. So the test is practical: how many words do you need to justify this opinion? The longer the justification, the more it is worth asking what it hides.

A question for you

What do you know about yourself that you keep offering excuses for?

Part 3 of 3

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوا۟ قَوَّٰمِينَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ شُهَدَآءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَوِ ٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ وَٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ ۚ إِن يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًا فَٱللَّهُ أَوْلَىٰ بِهِمَا ۖ فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن تَلْوُۥٓا۟ أَوْ تُعْرِضُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

O you who have believed, be persistently standing firm in justice, witnesses for Allāh, even if it be against yourselves or parents and relatives. Whether one is rich or poor, Allāh is more worthy of both.[223] So follow not [personal] inclination, lest you not be just. And if you distort [your testimony] or refuse [to give it], then indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

Translator's notes

[223] i.e., more knowledgeable of their best interests. Therefore, adhere to what He has enjoined upon you and testify honestly.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:135

Translation

“‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

Original · Hebrew

לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֨וֶל֙ בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא־תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־דָ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּצֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽךָ׃

the Torah (Leviticus) · 19:15

World English Bible

The last test is the strongest: will you say the truth when it goes against you? The verse asks for fair witness even against yourself, your parents, your kin, then names what prevents it: desire. An opinion that never costs you, never crosses you and always suits you leans toward ego. One you state even though it loses you something leans toward honesty. That is no proof, but it is a scale you can use.

A question for you

Which of the three tests is hardest for you?

If you sayNot clearing myself
ThenThen notice when you do it: sometimes before anyone has accused you.
If you saySeeing my excuses
ThenSeeing them is a large step, and you are seeing them now.
If you saySpeaking truth against myself
ThenIt is the hardest for everyone. The mercy named at the start of this is still here.

The same in the other books

Translation

But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed. Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

ἕκαστος δὲ πειράζεται ὑπὸ τῆς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας ἐξελκόμενος καὶ δελεαζόμενος· εἶτα ἡ ἐπιθυμία συλλαβοῦσα τίκτει ἁμαρτίαν, ἡ δὲ ἁμαρτία ἀποτελεσθεῖσα ἀποκύει θάνατον.

James · 1:14-15

World English Bible

Translation

I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

וָאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־שֹׁ֣פְטֵיכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹ֤עַ בֵּין־אֲחֵיכֶם֙ וּשְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין־אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵין־אָחִ֖יו וּבֵ֥ין גֵּרֽוֹ׃

the Torah (Deuteronomy) · 1:16

World English Bible

Translation

Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

μὴ κρίνετε κατʼ ὄψιν, ἀλλὰ τὴν δικαίαν κρίσιν κρίνετε.

the Gospel (John) · 7:24

World English Bible

If thou be the son of a man of the priesthood, and an envoy to conciliate the multitude,.... speak thou without favouring one side. Let it not be said, 'His conduct is that of the nobles, favouring one side in his speech.' Turn thine aim toward exact judgments.
